flora: Early_Angiosperms (primitive flowering shrubs clustered near rare washes)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; thick, chunky bark textures weathered by an arid environment; needles appear as soft, clustered tufts rather than sharp points to maintain a stylized aesthetic; focus on the verticality of a resilient desert survivor.

visual_logic.composition: A dramatic wide-angle shot looking up the massive trunk of a lone conifer towering over a dry flood plain. Strong structural branches stretch out against a vast geological landscape.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, sun-cracked dusty red mudflats with cross-bedded tan sandstone channels and scattered purple claystone fragments.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; intense, direct midday sun casting harsh cinematic shadows across the cracked earth, with a hot atmospheric glow on the distant desert horizon.
